title: Design System: PRIMOCOSMOS — Silicon Idol & Multimodal Signal Lab

display.purpose: Retained orbital-cover display token; the current home identity uses authored SVG lettering.

headline.purpose: Research title and complete paper titles.

title.purpose: Abstract, Method, Evaluation, and instrument subheads.

body.purpose: Chinese translation, explanation, evidence, and caveats.

label.purpose: Uppercase statuses, coordinates, controls, axes, and measurements.

mono.purpose: Dense SVG implementation annotations and editing telemetry.

math.purpose: Equation fields use Cambria Math with STIX Two Math, Latin Modern Math, Times New Roman, and serif fallbacks.

home-navigation.purpose: Home navigation only; responsive to 12px on narrow screens.

home-archive-title.purpose: Named real paper destinations on the independent home.

motion.name: dense-state
motion.purpose: SVG observation, node focus, decoder target, and objective-route changes.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Tab rail, disclosure chevron, skip link, and switch state transitions.

motion.name: directional-shift
motion.purpose: Diagram-operation changes and directional arrow travel.

motion.name: navigation-sweep
motion.purpose: Fixed-header underline reveal from left to right.

motion.name: iteration-step
motion.purpose: PnP-CoSMo CC/DC/CR automatic phase cadence when motion is allowed.

motion.name: reduced-motion-collapse
motion.purpose: Global transition and animation duration under prefers-reduced-motion; PnP transport becomes manual stepping.

motion.name: home-grazing-light
motion.purpose: Home material light only; pauses with the motion toggle, hidden tabs, or reduced motion.

motion.name: home-haze
motion.purpose: Home background haze only; same pause policy.

motion.name: home-parallax
motion.purpose: Bounded image-only pointer response; disabled for touch and reduced motion.

motion.name: home-departure
motion.purpose: Blade departure for unmodified same-tab navigation when motion is enabled; immediate routing otherwise.

motion.name: mmhvae-mathematical-cycle
motion.purpose: Deterministic local mathematical progression; manual scrubbing pauses playback and reduced motion disables automatic advancement.

home.rules: Silicon Idol monochrome material and authored lettering; does not redefine scientific data colors.

research.rules: Preserve incumbent scientific color semantics, controls, and content. Legacy orbital-cover rules do not apply to home.

mmhvae.rules: Existing module palette, vertical encoder towers and seven-level spatial hierarchy take precedence over generic planar-console guidance. Preserve local KaTeX, operator detail, and hierarchy browser.

extensions.notCanonized: Retired cover composition, exact image crop and glyph coordinates, passive metadata sizes, and incumbent research kickers are not new global rules. Exact teaching-grid sizes, per-family geometry dimensions and interpolation colors remain local implementation details rather than new global tokens.

atomicMathematics.form: vertical numeric 3D stages with external context rails
atomicMathematics.motion: bounded deterministic local transformation; pause, manual progress and reduced-motion support
atomicMathematics.truth: small teaching data, never trained inference
atomicMathematics.controls: Scrollable numbered steps, current formula and editable explanation, operator-specific probe/readout, pause and manual progress, native scale/index disclosure.
atomicMathematics.responsive: Two columns become one at 640px; fullscreen control panel scrolls within 34dvh, or 32dvh on narrow screens.
atomicMathematics.normalizationStages: Input values → squared centered deviations → normalized values.
atomicMathematics.numericalSource: Convolution geometry and control readout share convolutionDemo; other readouts follow the selected operator and coordinate.

narrative.overview:
PRIMOCOSMOS has two deliberately separate visual scopes. The home route uses the approved Silicon Idol identity: black sculptural material, white authored industrial lettering, a smooth curved sigil composed with the title without touching its letters, and restrained cold light. Research keeps its incumbent Deep-Space Telemetry Array notebook and scientific semantics. The shared identity and real paper destinations connect these scopes; their palettes and display treatments do not become interchangeable.

Scope authority: home rules apply to `src/components/home/` and `#/`; research rules apply to `src/ResearchPage.tsx`, the research components, and `#/research/<paper>`. The home wordmark preserves the exact spelling **PRIMOCOSMOS：SILICONDEVINE**. Its first-screen composition and generated colossus asset belong to `.impeccable/surfaces/src-components-home-home-tsx.md`, not a mandatory template for future pages. The legacy orbital-cover styles remain in the stylesheet but no longer define the home identity. Existing unprefixed frontmatter primitives remain research-scoped unless explicitly identified otherwise; `home-*` and `silicon-*` entries are home-scoped.

The notebook is intentionally dense and operational. Three mutually exclusive paper tabs expose complete notes in a stable Abstract → Method → Evaluation sequence. The Method band expands beyond the reading column and gives each paper a browser-native model laboratory: large labeled SVG schematics, controls that alter observed modalities or gradient routes, generated MRI slices, trend plots, formula disclosures, and plain-language status readouts. Expressive details must explain identity, hierarchy, state, information flow, or evidence—not decorate empty space.
keyCharacteristics: Independent monochrome industrial home and dense scientific notebook, joined by direct paper navigation.
Matte near-black and navy tonal decks, clipped instrument housings, one-pixel calibration rails, and almost no soft elevation.

Semantic signal colors: lime for observed/active/measurement state, blue for shared/reference structure, orange for correction or blocked gradients, and violet/coral/lavender for distinct latent factors.
One complete paper mounted at a time through a keyboard-operable, three-item tab bar.
Exhaustive interactive architectures whose controls, routes, captions, readouts, and equations stay synchronized.
Responsive reflow around scientific topology: existing planar diagrams scroll horizontally; MMHVAE preserves its vertical spatial hierarchy and accessible hierarchy browser.

rules.name: The Two-World Rule
rules.body: Keep the home’s monochrome industrial identity and the research notebook’s scientific color meanings scoped to their own surfaces.

rules.name: The Signal-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Lime means observed, active, or measurement-anchored; blue means shared, referenced, or informational; orange means corrective, stopped, or risky; violet, coral, and lavender separate latent factors. Every chromatic state also needs a label, position, icon, stroke, or shape cue.

rules.name: The Comparison-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber and green belong to comparative plot series. Do not promote them into navigation, calls to action, focus, or general decoration.

rules.name: The Phosphor Rarity Rule
rules.body: Lime is the sharpest voice and stays sparse outside active states, focus, measurements, and the primary entry action.

rules.name: The Authored Identity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the bespoke wordmark’s complete lettering and authored curved sigil, including the intentional gap between them; do not substitute a system display face or attach the symbol to letter strokes.

rules.name: The Four-Channel Type Rule
rules.body: Tektur carries identity, headings, measurements, and machine voice; the Chinese system-sans stack carries explanation and evidence; Cascadia Code carries micro notation and editing telemetry; the conventional math stack carries equations.

rules.name: The Readable Science Rule
rules.body: Sustained prose keeps generous 1.7–1.88 line height and restrained widths even when the surrounding console is dense.

rules.name: The Topology-First Responsive Rule
rules.body: Reflow prose, metadata, controls, and evidence freely, but preserve each model’s established topology: a focusable horizontal viewport for planar diagrams and vertical spatial hierarchy for MMHVAE.

rules.name: The One-Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep exactly one tabpanel mounted. The tab row is orientation-stable—three columns on wide screens and one horizontal scroller on narrow screens—so comparison order never changes.

rules.name: The Tonal-Deck Rule
rules.body: Use controlled near-black steps, strokes, clipping, and inset fields; do not introduce drop shadows, luminous card halos, or floating white surfaces.

rules.name: The One-Glass Exception Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur belongs to the fixed header only, never to paper tabs, notes, telemetry panels, or model consoles.

rules.name: The Hard-Housing Rule
rules.body: Structural containers are square or clipped; pill geometry belongs to touch targets, not content surfaces.

rules.name: The Operator Boundary Rule
rules.body: An atomic view explains only its own output. Noise generation does not perform the later scale/mean operations; weight accumulation does not construct the downstream posterior. Pure tensor leaves explain storage and indexing without inventing hidden networks.

rules.name: The Numerical Correspondence Rule
rules.body: The selected coordinate, scene value and control readout use the same operator-specific example. All examples are deterministic teaching data, not trained weights. Gaussian display height is explicitly scaled by eight for legibility; normalized probability remains separate from display coordinates. Blue/warm values distinguish positive/negative responses and pale highlights mark the current sample. Explanatory prose participates in the existing persistent editor.

dos: Do keep the Silicon Idol home and scientific notebook visually scoped while preserving their shared identity and real paper destinations.
Do use signal colors according to scientific meaning and repeat every color-coded state in text, geometry, iconography, stroke, or position.
Do keep paper switching as an accessible tab interaction with Arrow, Home, and End behavior and exactly one mounted panel.
Do preserve planar research canvases in their focusable horizontal scrollers and MMHVAE in its established vertical spatial hierarchy.

Do preserve the authored SVG home wordmark and keep the research title stack on Tektur Variable, long Chinese reading on the system-sans stack, diagram micro notation on Cascadia Code, and formulas on the declared conventional math stack.
Do keep focus visible, expose status changes in adjacent text or live regions, include SVG title/description, and make reduced-motion transport explicit.
donts: Don't turn either scope into a generic neon gradient, glassmorphism dashboard, or rounded SaaS card system; the home’s native cold lighting and MMHVAE’s spatial depth remain valid local materials.
Don't use lime, blue, orange, violet, coral, lavender, amber, or green interchangeably; every one has a defined data or comparison role.
Don't shrink, reorder, or redraw a scientific graph merely to fit a narrow viewport.
Don't round structural consoles, paper tabs, note blocks, or evidence ledgers; reserve pills for compact controls and source links.
Don't let an interactive diagram change without a readable label, caption, output, or status describing the new state.
Don't invent biography, affiliation, achievements, contacts, or additional research projects to fill the personal cover.
